recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-3255 unless a future work group decision reintroduces dedicated remarks semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-3255 was a Published FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to drop questionnaire.group.question.remarks because remarks should be modeled as a specific question, while still allowing questionnaire design to make that remarks question clearly a sub-question.
initial_application: Commit 54ddc30bbb4ff904ff5e5c0f7cce9088b15b19c6 split Questionnaire into Questionnaire and QuestionnaireAnswers and applied outstanding change requests; its parent still contained Questionnaire.group.question.remarks in source/questionnaire/questionnaire-spreadsheet.xml, while the commit no longer did. Commit 91c9acbdfbaaff19efcc86466a473f3312f130b8 later added the release-history note explicitly saying Questionnaire dropped questionnaire.group.question.remarks for tracker 3255.
additional_context: QuestionnaireAnswers is now represented in current core as QuestionnaireResponse, but the relevant current build-scope source is Questionnaire. source/fhir.ini has active Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse entries. Current Questionnaire.item models an ordered hierarchy of groups, display text, questions, and nested items, so remarks can be represented as a distinct nested item/question without a dedicated remarks element. No exact Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion. FHIR-3260 was encountered only because the same historical release note also mentions omitReason; it is a separate change and is not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because the current active Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse source has no questionnaire.group.question.remarks or remarks element, and the current recursive item model already supports the approved design approach for remarks as a sub-question.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same release-history line, but it concerns omitReason rather than questionnaire.group.question.remarks and was not decided here.
